value: Empathic concern discrepancy score correlated negatively with predominantly right-hemispheric gray matter volumes including the inferior and medial temporal gyri, temporal poles, anterior fusiform gyrus, and anterior parahippocampus.

Overestimation of one's empathic concern was predicted by predominantly right-hemispheric atrophy in anterior paralimbic and associative neocortical temporal brain regions and right posterior insula, with the most consistent and robust effects seen in the right anterior inferior temporal gyrus adjacent to the temporal pole, and the left anterior fusiform gyrus.
